RockTunnel_1F_Text_ArianaPostBattle.fr: Hé ben ! Me voilà en sueur !

RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonPostBattle.en: Oh well, I'll get a ZUBAT as I go!
RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonPostBattle.fr: Bon, il me faut un NOSFERAPTI !

RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaIntro.en: I came this far looking for wild\nPOKéMON.
RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaIntro.fr: Je suis venu jusqu'ici chercher des\nPOKéMON sauvages.

RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaPostBattle.en: You looked cute and harmless.\nWas I ever wrong!
RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaPostBattle.fr: Dire que je pensais que tu ne\nsavais pas te battre.

RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahIntro.en: Eek!\pDon't try anything funny in the\ndark!
RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahIntro.fr: Eek !\pTente rien de louche dans le\nnoir !

RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahPostBattle.en: I saw a MACHOP in this tunnel.
RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahPostBattle.fr: J'ai vu un MACHOC dans ce tunnel !

RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyIntro.en: This tunnel goes a long way, kid!

RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyPostBattle.en: Watch for ONIX.\nThey appear only occasionally.\pHigh-level ones can put the\nsqueeze on you!
RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyPostBattle.fr: Attention aux ONIX ! Ils\napparaissent souvent ici.\pIls pourraient facilement\nt'écrabouiller, fais attention !

RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasIntro.en: Outsiders like you need to show me\nsome respect!
RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasIntro.fr: Les étrangers comme toi doivent me\nmontrer du respect !

RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasPostBattle.fr: Tu as le niveau des meilleurs\nmontagnards !

RockTunnel_1F_Text_MonMachop.en: MACHOP: Gooh!\nIt is pushing a boulder around.

RockTunnel_1F_Text_MonNidorino.en: NIDORINO: Gyuu!\nIt sniffs around for ore.
RockTunnel_1F_Text_MonNidorino.fr: NIDORINO : Gyuu ! Il renifle à la\nrecherche de minerai.

RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverDefeat.en: Ease up!\nWhat am I doing?\lWhich way is out?
RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverDefeat.fr: Doucement ! Qu'est-ce que je fais ?\nPar où on sort ?

RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverIntro.en: Hmm. The map says I should be\nout by now. I run this project!\pFine, a battle then. Maybe the\nexit is behind you.
RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverIntro.fr: Hmm. La carte dit que je devrais\nêtre sorti. C'est moi qui dirige ce\lprojet !\pBon, un combat alors. La sortie est\npeut-être derrière toi.

RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverPostBattle.en: That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12\nforced me to take this detour.\pTell the team the schedule is\nfine. Mostly.
RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverPostBattle.fr: Ce POKéMON endormi sur la ROUTE 12\nm'a forcé à faire ce détour.\pDis à l'équipe que le planning est\nbon. En gros.
